name: Wrong Side of Mars
source:
Wrong Side of Mars is a sci-fi NTR visual novel diving into the collapse of a man's authority and his marriage under extreme isolation.

[Edited from [url=https://pure-angst-vn-studio.itch.io/wrong-side-of-mars]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《火星的错误面》是一部科幻NTR视觉小说，深入探讨了极端孤立下男人权威的崩溃和婚姻。

[编辑自[url=https://pure-angst-vn-studio.itch.io/wrong-side-of-mars]itch.io[/url]]
